science: Terminal FINITE-EXACT-INDEFINITE-REPEATABILITY-OBSTRUCTED-FOR-NONTRIVIAL-APPEND-IN-G_FIN_INFINITY — the autonomous-reusable-bath route proposed by #7806 as the way to fix beta is closed in its finite-memory branch. In-framework lemma: an append-only seven-state pointer channel has T(P_0) = h P_0 + sum_f p_f P_f and T(P_f) = P_f, so T(I) = h P_0 + sum_f (1+p_f) P_f, which equals I only for the trivial no-write channel — EVERY nontrivial append-only Record channel is nonunital, hence has a strictly positive entropy drop on the maximally mixed state (exactly log(7/6) for the symmetric fixture h=0, p_f=1/6). Combined with the fixed-finite-memory repeatable-channel bound n[S(rho)-S(T rho)] <= log dim(K) (imported at declared authority-gate scope from Rybar-Ziman Theorem 2 — an external import, flagged), the left side grows linearly in n while the right is finite, so no nontrivial append channel is exactly indefinitely repeatable under the five G_fin,infinity hypotheses (fixed finite memory, fixed unitary, factorized inputs, same exact map every use, arbitrarily many uses). Exact finite-use ceilings: dim K = 2, 7, 49 give 4, 12, 25 uses. Second independent negative that kills the #7806 shortcut: for f=+z the proper-cubic stabilizer has order 4 with control orbits {0}, {+z}, {-z}, {+x,-x,+y,-y}, so the invariant diagonal response F_f = u P_0 + a P_f + o P_{-f} + p sum_perp P_g has dimension 4 and u, o, p stay INDEPENDENT — control-complement blindness (u=o=p, which would give beta=1) has codimension two and is NOT a consequence of covariance, so any tie is an assumed or relocated selector, and the Block19 beta projection is only legal after o=p. Three further controls: the pure exact-return catalyst forces all six blank-to-mark write amplitudes to zero by inner-product preservation; a G_fin,2 two-ready-factor memory succeeds twice then fails on use three (witness (0,0,1) -> (1,1,0)) with a reachable-state lock failure, so two uses never imply indefinite reuse; and beta = exp(-theta Delta E) merely RELOCATES the free dimensionless coordinate into temperature/gap/spectral/coupling/cadence data rather than deriving it. Scope kept honest: an explicit steelman (infinite translating chiral field with stationary incoming boundary state and an outgoing archive carrying entropy away) is preserved as live, so no bath-wide no-go is claimed.
